description: Top questions on an AskOnce board, ranked by how many attendees asked them plus upvotes. Use this to tell a speaker what the audience most wants to know.

configuration.query: FROM questions | WHERE board == ?board | SORT popularity DESC, updatedAt DESC | KEEP text, asks, votes, popularity, variants | LIMIT 10

board.description: AskOnce board name, for example demo-k8s-talk
